v: Probably the first FAMILY movie you should never watch with family 😉 Vanga goes full mad mode here. WOW, WTF, delight, disgust... everything at once. Ranbir is 🔥
e: ANIMAL is less a conventional movie and more an intentionally extreme experience: violent, vulgar, technically polished, frequently excessive and impossible to react to with a single emotion. Ranbir is phenomenal, the BGM and cinematography elevate the madness, and Sandeep Reddy Vanga goes far beyond anything he attempted in Arjun Reddy.
body:
Sandeep Reddy Vanga is probably the first director in the History of World Cinema who made a Family Movie which cannot be watched with Family 😉

Rajamouli was absolutely right in saying Sandeep Reddy Vanga is this generation’s Ram Gopal Varma…..this film is atleast 10x of what Arjun Reddy was 🙏 in all aspects

If you are a traditional film lover or the one of those intellectuals who question how can a single person bash 100’s of persons, If you are a feminist, if you are the one who cant handle vulgar actions and dialogues on screen….then this movie is not for you, please don’t waste your time

This is not a movie which can be handled by regular movie goers…..it’s an EXPERIENCE where you have wow moments & what the fuck moments equally….in some portions you will sympathise with the lead actor and in few you will hate him to the core, in some parts you will feel how well its been portrayed and in some you will feel its dragged to the core 🙏 All in All its a Movie of Mixed Emotions….where you experience everything starting from DELIGHT to DISGUST, from being WOW to being YACK!!!

starting with Technicalities, the title ANIMAL is apt suited for this movie with well designed BGM and CINEMATOGRAPHY to up the visual and audio experience of whats being unleashed on screen…..

Acting wise….there is no doubt who is going to win all the famous awards this season and its Ranbir Kapoor for sure, Anil Kapoor did a terrific job as Dad and I was pleasantly surprised with the characterisation and acting of Rashmika, if at all there is any sensible char in this movie thats is of Geethanjali played by Rashmika 🙏

All others characters played their part really well….and though it was more of a special cameo out of almost 3.5 hrs movie Bobby Deol did a terrific job

Post Kabir Singh (Hindi version of Arjun Reddy) Sandeep openly said in few interviews that he was hurt with few reviewers calling it a Violent movie and he will make a movie to show them what actual Violence is….. And I am still in trance of why and how he chose a Family Back Drop to showcase such mad violence, definitely he is Content Creator with IRON BALLS 🙏

v: BOLD, RAW, RUSTIC... and absolutely not for sensitive viewers 🙏 Payal goes all in, Ajay Bhupathi doesn’t play safe and that BGM + camera work are 🔥
e: MANGALAVAARAM impressed me with both its courage and its craft. Ajay Bhupathi tackles physically and emotionally disturbing material without playing safe, Payal Rajput gives an exhausting committed performance, and the cinematography and Ajaneesh Loknath’s BGM turn the thriller into a haunting audiovisual experience.
body:
I bow down to the Brilliance of Ajay Bhupathi and his team 🙏

Never expected an out & out BOLD, RAW & RUSTIC Telugu movie which throws a direct slap on the face of Hypocritical Society and gives a valuable lesson of rather than Judging a Book by its Cover we should understand what is going on with a person both Physically & Mentally!!!

It needs Guts to write such a story and execute it to near perfection…..and also needs guts to play such a Bold and Emotionally Exhausting Role irrespective of how their current career is and hats-off to Payal for pulling out that role 🫡

Cinematography by Dasaradhi Sivendra is top notch and almost 75% frames of the movie are wall paper worthy 😍 and especially the scenes shot in low light are worth watching!!!!

Music & BGM by Ajaneesh Loknath is the soul of this Thriller which can give Anirudh’s BGM a Run for their money…….and it was no surprise for me when I came to know that he is also the Music Director for Kantara 😍

Each and every Character of the story played an excellent role to give that Thriller feeling……special Shout Out to Ajay Gosh, he was awesome 👍

Having said all the above this movie is a strict NO for the Sensible persons who can’t handle Guts Wrenching Emotions associated with Sexual and Physical Abuse…..so if you are sensitive to the above its better to skip this movie else the visuals will haunt you 😞

v: Finally a good Salman movie after ages 🙏 Story is thin and I’m tired of Pakistan spy stories, but Bhai + Katrina + action make it a decent festival watch 😉
e: Tiger 3 finally gives Salman Khan a solid commercial film again. The story is wafer-thin and YRF’s Pakistan obsession is exhausting, but Salman-Katrina chemistry, entertaining action and the franchise’s continued respect for its female lead make it a decent spy entertainer.
body:
Kabhi EID…..Kabhi DIWALI

BHAI ke movie binnaa….Festival hai AADHURI 😉😉

A Good Film by Salman after ages 🙏🙏🙏🙏 which makes it a Decent watch….when I say Decent its just because of the high dose of Spy Thrillers in Bollywood

When it comes to Bollywood Spy Thrillers and especially Yash Raj’s Spy Universe I don’t understand why they are so obsessed with Pakistan and this movie took it to a notch higher with Indian Raw Agent trying to uplift the Democracy in Pakistan 🙏. Though it sounds over the top but Anything is possible with Salman Bhai and at least for me it looked convincing 👍. Hope this is the last spyverse movie obsessed with Pakistan 🙏

I love Tiger Franchise for being the first fully commercial Top Star movie giving equal importance to Female Lead characterisation and good to see that they still continued doing that….as with any other Spy Movie tough the story line is wrapper thin and has its own flaws, The Action Scenes and the Actors chemistry make it up to a good watch if not must watch!!!

For the people who are comparing Tiger3 craze with Pathan, I just want to remind them that the craze for Pathaan was just for the fact that SRK os doing a spy thriller for the very first time and I wonder if he can pull the same craze for the next part of Pathan (if there is any) but Salman Khan doing that effortlessly even with 3rd Instalment of Tiger shows his command over masses and all he needs is to bend his back and select good scripts ( but a serious NO to TUBELIGHT 😉)

The only disappointment I had with this movie is with its Music…forget about Pathaan even the first two instalments of Tiger had very peppy songs….but these songs are 😏

v: Nolan gaadi movies decode cheyatam kaadhu raaa... dammunte SKANDA decode cheyandi 🙏🤣 Ram looks good, dances well... migatha antha Boyaaa universe torture.
e: SKANDA lost me from the very first scene and never found a way back. A hero introduced as a foreign-university topper and ethical hacker solves everything by flexing muscles, the action becomes parody-level excess, and Thaman’s usually helpful BGM only amplifies the chaos.
body:
Nolan gadi movies decode cheyatam kadhuraaaa…..meeku dammunte maa Boyaaa anna Skanda decode cheyandi 🙏🙏🙏

This is how the product is made when the makers think that their audience are senseless….Agreed that there are many out and out illogical mass masala movies which have become blockbusters in recent past but they were successful in grabbing the audience attention in at-least one or other department and thus making them completely forget about the logics and enjoy what is shown, but unfortunately in Skanda you get disconnected right from the first scene itself and the there is no point of getting reconnected to the movie or the plot.

When you establish the Hero’s character as a Foreign University Topper and outstanding Ethical Hacker…then the least we expect is that he uses his INTELLIGENCE in cornering the Villains (in this case 2 states CM’s 🤣😉) BUT BUT BUT thats Nolans way of movie making but in Boya’s way the heros just flexes his muscle power and thats it 🙏

Looks like all the action scenes where choreographed by Mutton Kottu Masthan 🤣 Generally Thaman has this ability to take an ordinary scene to next level with his BGM and that has become a huge minus for this movie as the scenes were already Over the Top and with his BGM they were just unbearable 🫡

Taking wise the movie is shot in typical Boya’s style where the screen is filled with hundreds of character artists whose only duty is to get dressed and give over expressions and deliver over the top dialogues praising the Hero/Villan 🙏

The only positives about this movie are Ram’s Looks and Ram-Sreeleela’s dances!!! Except them everything else is unbearable
